column1: # Used by VisionCalibrationEngine to define where to collect vision calibration data
#   name: Unique identifier for this calibration point (e.g.
#   x_meters: Field X coordinate in meters (0-8.2 typical)
#   y_meters: Field Y coordinate in meters (0-4.1 typical)
#   rotation_degrees: Robot heading in degrees (0=facing red side
#   initial_position: true if this is the calibration starting/reset position
#   - Exactly ONE point must have initial_position=true (your starting/reference position)
#   - All other points (initial_position=false) are ABSOLUTE field positions
#   - Robot will reset odometry at each point when operator clicks "Start This Point"
